items.objective: Use the row-wise r-k-c rank-1 update as the primary experiment: compare its contiguous B/C traversal and compiler vectorization with the original r-c-k loop, first with a simple serial variant. If search results warrant it, test row-parallel, unrolling, or other correctness-preserving variants as separately measured follow-ups; distinguish traversal gains from those added changes. Stay within the caller’s thread budget. Check overwrite behavior and the fixed oracle tolerance on all official sizes, compare repeated native n=1024 timings, and record unsuccessful variants.
